scope: Selected product decision implementation gate for provenance-derived local cross-track ActualRouteBodyCore continuity. It authorizes only the scoped production-source and CPU/static implementation below; it does not authorize GPU execution, readiness, capture authorization, machine/TA acceptance, or product exposure.

root_product_decision_binding.selection_statement: ROOT PRODUCT DECISION: SELECTED LOCAL_CROSS_TRACK_ACTUAL_CONTINUITY_PRIORITY from Phase4 V15 independent TA decision gate SHA 2628104e6d219a98fb38fa599058ec3dd22f11c658d7fe3aa1ffc82850bcf23b.

candidate_eligibility_contract.prior_actual_requirement: The sample was covered before predicted submission by renderer-tagged ActualRouteBodyCore, never by actual halo/rim/tick/endpoint/marker or a color-equivalent scene pixel.
candidate_eligibility_contract.true_crossing_requirement: At the physical sample, predicted coverage contains at least two distinct provenance keys; each key is exactly (arc_segment_id, normalized_primitive_stem), with _core and _halo removed only for stem normalization.
forbidden_candidates: semantic-gap cap intrusion that is not a true crossing
single predicted stem represented by both _core and _halo
endpoint, tick, marker, outer side band
unowned, foreign, double-assigned, stale, or ambiguous provenance

minimum_connected_selection_algorithm.input_domain: All physical framebuffer samples generated from the shared projection and semantic batches; acceptance coordinates are probes only and may not enter production selection logic.
minimum_connected_selection_algorithm.connectivity: 8-connected within the same physical sample plane and prior actual route arc.
minimum_connected_selection_algorithm.crossing_island: One 8-connected component of true-crossing candidate samples, plus every baseline-surviving ActualRouteBodyCore 8-component touching that candidate component.
minimum_connected_selection_algorithm.baseline_survivor: A prior ActualRouteBodyCore sample already surviving without changing protected predicted ownership under the V15 frozen semantic-gap-only rule.
minimum_connected_selection_algorithm.objective: For each crossing island, select the minimum-cardinality subset S of eligible true-crossing candidates such that largest8(baseline_survivors union S) >= 2.
minimum_connected_selection_algorithm.already_satisfied: If baseline survivor largest8>=2, select zero samples.
minimum_connected_selection_algorithm.fail_closed: If no eligible subset reaches 2, select zero, report an explicit selector error, and do not broaden eligibility.
deterministic_tie_break: minimum row-major ordered tuple list using (sample_index, physical_y, physical_x)
minimum_connected_selection_algorithm.selected_mask_semantics: Only the selected samples may let prior ActualRouteBodyCore survive predicted route-body ownership; all other samples retain frozen actual-then-predicted behavior.

trajectory_package_cpu_selector: Emit renderer-only sample provenance for prior ActualRouteBodyCore and predicted (arc, normalized-stem) coverage from unchanged projected triangles.
Compute the generic crossing islands and deterministic minimum selection mask without reading capture ID, camera name, fixture ID, or the three acceptance coordinates.

Store a bounded sparse selected-crossing sample mask and diagnostics; do not modify vertices, colors, widths, cap geometry, dash geometry, source probes, tokens, semantic batches, source IDs, or draw order.
Fail closed on duplicate/unowned/foreign provenance, invalid dimensions/sample positions, mask overflow, or a selection that is non-minimal/non-connected.
modern_renderer_sample_mask_pipeline: Own non-color integer prior-actual-core and selected-crossing masks, cleared every frame and recreated on resize/context loss. No HDR/RGB equality or capture instrumentation may choose a sample.

Freeze the prior ActualRouteBodyCore mask after actual submission and before predicted submission. Upload/bind the CPU-selected crossing mask using the same physical sample convention; never sample an attached target.

Before predicted color and ownership writes, preserve prior actual only when both masks are positive for that exact sample and the submission is predicted route body. Endpoint/tick/marker and samples outside the selected mask retain baseline behavior.
MSAA handling must be sample-aware or conservatively fail closed; normalized averaging, unresolved integer aliasing, or one-pixel blanket suppression is forbidden.
Keep exactly two trajectory color submissions in actual-then-predicted order; bookkeeping masks are not a new product color pass.
unchanged_visual_contract: Predicted yellow identity and dominance remain unchanged away from selected crossing samples.
Predicted 18/12/30 dash rhythm, endpoint markers, ticks, centerlines, widths, offsets, cap envelopes, side-only rim, and source ownership remain unchanged.
The 2px predicted inner annulus remains physically intact everywhere outside selected true-crossing samples.
Standard and CVD use topology-identical selection; hue never selects or breaks a tie.

allowed_files.allowed: Generic sample-provenance raster, crossing-island minimum selector, selected-mask emission, diagnostics and fail-closed errors only.
Bounded renderer-only provenance/selected-sample structs, diagnostics and error fields only; no product model or authority field.
Integer mask resource lifecycle, exact actual-freeze/selected-mask binding, predicted route-body sample predicate, and CPU/static inspectable shader contract only.
Read-only metrics for mask dimensions/count/freeze/use, selector status and unchanged submission order only.
One CPU/static implementation test target and compile definition only; no shipping flags/link/runtime changes.
Positive, negative, minimality, source-ID, visual-regression, controls and static shader fixtures only.
Future fail-closed receipt/input mutation tests only.

required_fixtures: all_existing trajectory ownership telemetry and renderer CPU suites pass

forbidden_changes: No capture ID, fixture ID, camera name, [783,413], [892,491], [940,525], or selected-output coordinate literal in production selection logic.
No global actual-over-predicted priority and no suppression outside the minimum selected true-crossing sample mask.
No non-cross dash-on, same-stem _core/_halo, endpoint, tick, marker, outer rim, scene-color, actual-halo, ambiguous, foreign, double, or unowned sample selection.
No threshold, visible region, largest8, contrast, source-count, ownership, acceptance-helper, or telemetry semantic change.
No route, centerline, width, cap, dash on/off/period/phase, offset, camera, viewport, layout, asset, UI, replay, authority, or product exposure change.
No source ID/count/order/digest or three repair-ID substitution, removal, reordering, coordinate retargeting, or color-selected topology.
No extra color draw, predicted-before-actual reorder, z-order-only workaround, HDR/RGB equality, stale mask, framebuffer feedback, unresolved MSAA alias, or fail-open resource fallback.
No files outside allowed_files and no GPU execution, readiness, capture authorization, machine/TA/targeted5/targeted11/formal68/M3/golden/beta/product claim from this gate.
